name: Abschlussfahrt
intro: Das Design für die Abschlussfahrt oder Mannschaftstour. Name, Ziel, Jahr - und auf Wunsch euer Vereinslogo und die Sportart.
variations:
central motif: a suitcase covered in travel stickers with a pennant
central motif: a tour bus on a winding road with the team waving from the windows (abstract figures)
central motif: a compass rose and a folded map with a route line
central motif: a globe with a pin in the destination
central motif: a vintage travel ticket layout with stamps
central motif: a mountain range with a rising sun and a road
central motif: a city skyline silhouette of the destination in a badge
central motif: a backpack, a camera and a pennant arranged like a crest
central motif: a big year number block with a travel stamp
central motif: a train crossing a bridge, steam or speed lines

upload.label: Vereinslogo (optional)
upload.hint: PNG mit freigestelltem Hintergrund wird am schönsten. Wird unverändert eingesetzt.

prompt:
Retro travel-and-team T-shirt print, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

A bold arched headline at the top carries the main text, which reads exactly "{crew}".
[[A straight banner line under the headline reads exactly "{ziel}".]]
[[A small pennant or stamp near the bottom reads exactly "{jahr}".]]
[[A small handwritten line at the very bottom reads exactly "{spruch}".]]

[[Include a subtle motif that clearly evokes the sport "{sportart}" - for example the matching ball or a piece of equipment for that sport - worked into the composition as a small graphic accent, not as text.]]

Do not invent or draw any club emblem, crest, shield or badge anywhere - if the team has one, it is added afterwards as a real file and the design is built around it. Leave no empty area, plate or frame for it: the artwork is complete in itself.

Style: vintage varsity and travel-badge look, two strong colors plus cream, thick block lettering with an inline stroke, pennants and stripes, light distressed texture, no gradients, no photorealism.
